title: PayGroupDeductions
description: The list of general deductions that have been set up for a given client. A deduction is something that is never added to gross and never deducted from net. A general deduction is an deduction that is not associated to a payroll feature. General deductions are informational and not taxed. deductions that are associated to payroll features may or may not be taxed depending on the rules of that feature
